summary: Sonida Senior Living, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an equity distribution agreement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $250 million of common stock. The company appointed multiple sales agents and forward purchasers, including RBC Capital Markets and Goldman Sachs. Sales will be made at prevailing market prices under Rule 415. No premium, price per share, or definitive terms are stated. This is a routine shelf takedown establishing an ATM program, not a transformative special situation. The filing discloses structural mechanics for forward sales via master confirmations. There is no deal-specific catalyst; the event is an ordinary capital markets activity. Watch for periodic disclosures of sales under the ATM program if material.
